hf_context_source: AlbertConfig.max_position_embeddings (config.json plbert.max_position_embeddings); KModel.context_length; KModel.forward asserts len(input_ids)+2 <= 512

multichip_decoder.scheme: head-parallel TP attention (3 local heads/device) + sequence-parallel FFN (replicated FFN weights) + sequence-sharded residual [b,1,S/4,H]; 1 all_gather + 1 reduce_scatter per layer
multichip_decoder.limiting_reason: none - TP fits with wide margin; context unchanged
multichip_decoder.per_device_weight_breakdown: attention weights FRACTURED to 1/TP (qkv [768,576] + dense [192,768] BFP8 ~0.62 MB); FFN weights REPLICATED full (ffn [768,2048] + ffn_out [2048,768] BFP8 ~3.3 MB); embeddings+map+norms replicated bf16 ~0.32 MB. Total ~4.3 MB/device.
multichip_decoder.kv_cache_note: N/A - non-autoregressive bidirectional encoder, no KV cache (same as stages 01/02).
multichip_decoder.per_device_dram_gb_approx: p300c per-device DRAM is many GB; ~4.3 MB weights + ~<50 MB activations/trace is a rounding error, so TP is not memory-motivated here - it is a latency/compute-parallelism play. No hard physical limit forces any context reduction.
multichip_decoder.seq_padding: public API accepts any length 1..512; internally padded to a multiple of TP*TILE=128 so each sequence shard is tile-aligned; padded keys masked in SDPA, output sliced to logical length. No aligned-only public contract.
notes: Tensor parallelism REDUCES per-device attention-weight memory (1/4) and keeps FFN replicated; both are tiny. Context stays 512 (advertised = supported), no capability reduction.
Because there is no KV cache, TP does not change any cache footprint; the only per-device memory items are the (tiny) weights, activations and the trace buffer.

optimized_multichip_decoder.scheme: Same TP=4 head-parallel attention + sequence-parallel FFN + sequence-sharded residual [b,1,S/4,H] as multichip_decoder; adds (1) block-sharded L1 LayerNorm (32-core (8,m_tiles) grid, InterleavedToSharded/ShardedToInterleaved around each in-layer norm) and (2) persistent preallocated CCL output/intermediate buffers for the per-layer all_gather + reduce_scatter. 1 all_gather + 1 reduce_scatter per layer unchanged.
optimized_multichip_decoder.limiting_reason: none - optimization preserves context 512 (advertised = supported); PCC preserved (worst vs single-chip 0.99802, vs HF 0.99694).
optimized_multichip_decoder.per_device_added_persistent_buffers: persistent CCL buffers (bf16, DRAM, per traced shape): all_gather out [b,1,S,768] + reduce_scatter intermediate [b,1,S,768] + reduce_scatter out [b,1,S/4,768]. At b=1,S=512 that is ~0.75+0.75+0.19 = ~1.7 MB/device/shape; DRAM is many GB so no capacity pressure and NO context reduction.
optimized_multichip_decoder.kv_cache_note: N/A - non-autoregressive bidirectional encoder, no KV cache (same as stages 01/02/03).
optimized_multichip_decoder.inter_layer_residual_contract: UNCHANGED from multichip_decoder: the decoder layer input AND output is the sequence-sharded residual [b,1,S/TP,H] in DRAM-interleaved bf16. There is NO gather/reshard/all-reduce between decoder layers; each layer internally does exactly 1 all_gather (residual->full seq, feeds QKV) + 1 reduce_scatter (WO partial->seq shard). The sharded LayerNorm's InterleavedToSharded/ShardedToInterleaved conversions are INTERNAL to a layer and return the residual to the interleaved sequence-shard contract before the layer boundary. Full-model bringup must preserve this sequence-sharded [b,1,S/TP,H] inter-layer contract (do not insert a layer-to-layer all_gather).
notes: Optimization is a latency play only (sharded norm + persistent CCL); it does not change parallelization, dtype policy, context, or the inter-layer residual layout. capability_reduction=false.

full_model.component: KokoroModel = full optimized-multichip plbert encoder + tied-embedding reconstruction readout (models/autoports/hexgrad_kokoro_82m/tt/model.py, tt/generator.py)
full_model.scheme: Preserves the optimized_multichip_decoder VERBATIM (TP=4 head-parallel attention + sequence-parallel FFN + sequence-sharded residual [b,1,S/TP,H], bf16 act / BFP8 linear weights / HiFi2 / fp32-dest-acc, block-sharded L1 LayerNorm, persistent CCL, 1 all_gather + 1 reduce_scatter per layer). Adds a terminal reconstruction readout matmul (per-token, run on the sequence shard) + on-device argmax; only tiny logits/token tensors gather at the boundary. No inter-layer all_gather added.
full_model.limiting_reason: none - full model preserves context 512 (advertised = supported); PCC vs HF >= 0.995 at every tested length (worst 0.99700 @T=128), prefill reconstruction top-1/5/100 = 100%, teacher-forcing top-5 0.9955 / top-100 1.0.
full_model.per_device_weight_breakdown: optimized_multichip decoder weights ~4.39 MB/device (attention fractured 1/TP + FFN replicated + embeddings/map/norms) PLUS the folded reconstruction readout weight W_readout[H=768, vocab_padded=192] bf16 replicated = 768*192*2 = ~0.295 MB/device. Total ~4.69 MB/device.
full_model.kv_cache_note: N/A - non-autoregressive bidirectional encoder, no KV cache / paged cache / current-position state (same as stages 01/02/03/04). 'decode' is a stateless full-sequence traced re-encode (decode == prefill).
full_model.per_device_added_persistent_buffers: Same persistent CCL buffers as optimized_multichip (~1.7 MB/device/shape at b=1,S=512). Token-out decode adds the captured encode+readout+argmax trace over stable sequence-sharded inputs. DRAM is many GB, so no capacity pressure and NO context reduction.
full_model.dram_capacity_note: p300c per-device DRAM is many GB; ~4.69 MB weights + ~<50 MB activations/trace/CCL is a rounding error. No hard physical limit forces any context or batch reduction. Weight + KV-cache (0) DRAM recomputed for the full 12-layer stack + readout above.
full_model.batch_contract: Batch-1 is the primary latency target (Kokoro's single-utterance serving regime). Batch dims are not hard-coded: prepare_inputs/forward/prefill_forward/decode_forward carry an explicit batch dim; PCC validated at batch 4 (0.998881) and decoder stage tested batch up to 32.
full_model.seq_padding: Public generator/model accept any logical length 1..512 including non-tile-aligned (31,33,127,200,511 validated at PCC>=0.995); padded internally to a TP*TILE=128 multiple, masked, sliced back to logical length. No aligned-only public contract.
notes: The full-model stage is the plbert encoder assembled with a reconstruction readout (LM-head analog). Kokoro's true full TTS pipeline (bert_encoder + predictor + ISTFTNet decoder + text_encoder) is out of scope for this stage (start-from-decoder contract) and is not autoregressive either.

Autoregressive contract items (KV cache, paged cache, current-position advance, on-device token-feedback loop) are N/A for a stateless bidirectional encoder; the model-appropriate equivalents (stateless decode==prefill, on-device greedy argmax with no host argmax/logits readback, traced re-encode) are implemented and validated.

optimized_full_model.component: KokoroModel (stage-05 full model) with an OPTIMIZED terminal token-out path (models/autoports/hexgrad_kokoro_82m/tt/model.py). The stage-04 optimized_multichip_decoder and stage-05 generator orchestration are preserved VERBATIM; only _argmax_seq and _readout changed.
optimized_full_model.scheme: Same as full_model (TP=4 head-parallel attention + sequence-parallel FFN + sequence-sharded residual [b,1,S/TP,H], bf16 act / BFP8 linear weights / HiFi2 / fp32-dest-acc, block-sharded L1 LayerNorm, persistent CCL, 1 all_gather + 1 reduce_scatter/layer, inter-layer residual layout preserved, terminal reconstruction readout + on-device greedy argmax). Stage-06 optimizes the terminal path only: (1) greedy argmax untilizes the logits shard to ROW_MAJOR so ttnn.argmax runs MULTI-CORE (6 cores, 36us) instead of SINGLE-CORE on TILE (1 core, 112us) @T=128; (2) the readout (LM-head) matmul uses an explicit MatmulMultiCoreReuseMultiCast program config (in0_block_w=8) instead of the auto core_grid (17us -> 4-5us).
optimized_full_model.limiting_reason: none - optimization is latency-only; context 512 preserved (advertised = supported), PCC vs HF >= 0.995 at every tested length (worst 0.996999 @T=128), prefill top-1/5/100 = 100%, teacher-forcing top-5 0.9955 / top-100 1.0 (unchanged from full_model - argmax result is bit-identical).
optimized_full_model.per_device_weight_breakdown: UNCHANGED from full_model (~4.69 MB/device). No new weights; the readout program config is a launch-time config, not a tensor.
optimized_full_model.kv_cache_note: N/A - non-autoregressive bidirectional encoder (same as stages 01-05).
optimized_full_model.per_device_added_persistent_buffers: UNCHANGED from full_model. The stage-06 argmax path allocates a transient ROW_MAJOR logits copy [b,1,S/TP,vocab_padded] inside the captured trace (freed each replay via the trace's own lifetime); vocab_padded=192 so at b=1,S=512 that is <0.05 MB/device - a rounding error, no capacity pressure, NO context reduction.
optimized_full_model.inter_layer_residual_contract: UNCHANGED from optimized_multichip_decoder / full_model: sequence-sharded [b,1,S/TP,H], no layer-to-layer gather added. The terminal gather is confined to the tiny token/logits tensors at the model boundary.
notes: Optimization preserves parallelization, dtype/fidelity/CCL policy, rejection ledger, inter-layer residual layout, context, batch, and non-aligned prompt support. capability_reduction=false.

Full-model token-out overhead over the decoder-layer-stack lower bound dropped from 7.8%/18.3% (T128/T512, stage-05) to 2.4%/6.6% (stage-06), both within the 10-15% target. See doc/optimized_full_model/perf_summary.json.

datatype_sweep.component: KokoroModel full model with the datatype-sweep-SELECTED precision policy (doc/datatype_sweep/selected_precision_config.json), loaded by default via tt/precision_config.load_selected -> build_generator.
datatype_sweep.selected_policy: attn/mlp/map weights BFP8, activations bf16, matmul+SDPA HiFi2, fp32 dest acc, LayerNorm HiFi4, CCL (all_gather + reduce_scatter) bf16, readout/logits bf16, greedy on-device argmax.
datatype_sweep.limiting_reason: none - the selected config is the canonical BFP8/HiFi2 policy (== stage 02/04/05/06); it does not change any dtype/layout vs optimized_full_model, so context is preserved (advertised = supported = 512). last_hidden_state PCC vs HF >= 0.995 at every tested length incl. non-aligned (worst 0.996999 @T=128; non-aligned 31/33/127/200/511 all >= 0.9970 via the selected-config default path, doc/datatype_sweep/non_aligned_check.json), prefill top-1/5/100 = 1.0, teacher-forcing top-5 0.9955 / top-100 1.0.
datatype_sweep.kv_cache_note: N/A - non-autoregressive bidirectional encoder, no KV cache / paged cache / current-position state (same as stages 01-06). The datatype sweep therefore has NO KV-cache dtype axis and NO candidate that changes memory capacity via a KV cache; no context recomputation from a KV-cache dtype change is required. 'decode' is a stateless full-sequence traced re-encode (decode == prefill).
datatype_sweep.per_device_weight_breakdown: UNCHANGED from optimized_full_model (~4.69 MB/device): selected config keeps BFP8 attention (fractured 1/TP) + BFP8 FFN (replicated) + BFP8 map + bf16 embeddings/norms + bf16 folded readout. No dtype change vs the prior stage, so no weight-memory change.
datatype_sweep.dram_capacity_note: p300c per-device DRAM is many GB; ~4.69 MB weights + KV cache (0) + ~<50 MB activations/trace/CCL is a rounding error. No hard physical limit forces any context/batch reduction, and the selected config does not reduce advertised capability. All swept lower-precision candidates (BFP8-LoFi, BFP4, BFP8-CCL) would REDUCE per-device memory further, so none is rejected for a capacity reason; they are rejected for last_hidden_state fidelity / top-1/5 accuracy (see doc/datatype_sweep/sweep_results.json).
datatype_sweep.seq_padding: UNCHANGED from optimized_full_model: public API accepts any logical length 1..512 incl. non-tile-aligned (31/33/127/200/511 re-validated at PCC>=0.995 for the selected config); padded internally to a TP*TILE=128 multiple, masked, sliced back. No aligned-only public contract. Selected dtype/layout does not change chunking.
notes: The datatype sweep selects the fastest config (by trace-verified teacher-forcing decode t/s/u) that satisfies top-1>=90%, top-5>=98%, and last_hidden_state PCC>=0.995. That is the BFP8/HiFi2 baseline, which introduces no dtype/layout/context change vs optimized_full_model; capability_reduction=false.
post-selection token-out (default selected-config path): T128 560 t/s/u (1.785 ms), T512 395 t/s/u (2.531 ms), eager TTFT@128 10.7 ms (doc/datatype_sweep/post_selection_tokenout.json).
Kokoro-82M is a non-autoregressive StyleTTS2/ISTFTNet TTS model. Its only attention-transformer component is plbert (HF AlbertModel). This functional decoder brings up that encoder in TTNN.

The model has NO causal transformer decoder, NO KV cache, and NO token-by-token decode. 'context length' here is the ALBERT max_position_embeddings (512 phoneme positions), which is the model's hard positional-embedding limit and also the KModel forward assertion bound.
Full advertised context (512) is tested in both prefill and traced decode with no reduction; the model fits comfortably on a single Blackhole p300c device (bert weights ~0.13 GB in bf16).
Model's minimum valid input is 3 tokens (BOS + >=1 phoneme + EOS).
Stage 01 functional decoder ran the encoder at bf16 weights / fp32 activations.

Stage 02 optimized decoder (tt/optimized_decoder.py) runs at bf16 activations + BFP8 linear weights (HiFi2, fp32 dest accumulation). Both of these dtype changes REDUCE persistent memory vs the functional decoder (weights ~0.13 GB bf16 -> ~0.065 GB BFP8; activations fp32 -> bf16), so capacity is not reduced: advertised = supported = 512 remains, tested at 512 in prefill and traced decode with PCC >= 0.995 (worst 0.99674). capability_reduction stays false. No KV cache / trace-buffer / CCL allocation exists to change (non-autoregressive, single device).
